fields.hero_title: A real CMS runtime before pixel confidence
fields.hero_body: This disposable fixture proves WordPress + ACF PRO + browser QA without standardizing a company's theme architecture or a future Figma LP structure.

cards.title: Observe the reference
cards.body: Read structure, responsive evidence, assets, and interaction before deciding implementation architecture.

cards.title: Map CMS ownership
cards.body: Only editor-owned content becomes ACF data. Visual repetition alone does not create CMS repetition requirements.

cards.title: Render through WordPress
cards.body: The QA target is the real WordPress page populated through ACF, not a detached static HTML approximation.

cards.title: Mutate without redesigning
cards.body: Stress count, copy length, missing media, order, and responsive widths separately from Figma fidelity scoring.
